digest_title: Canonical Kubernetes 1.36 Release Requires Live Network Path Verification
dek: Canonical Kubernetes 1.36 introduces routing changes and removes k8s-dqlite, requiring defenders to verify live network paths and datastore readiness.
overview: Canonical Kubernetes 1.36 changes service routing, component versions, and datastore support. Defenders must verify live paths and inventory states rather than relying on version checks.

stories.headline: Canonical Kubernetes 1.36 Upgrade Changes Routing and Datastore
stories.summary: Canonical Kubernetes 1.36 removes kube-proxy on new clusters using Cilium, deprecates specific settings, and makes etcd the only supported built-in datastore.
stories.why_it_matters: Identical versions can have different packet paths and failure modes, making verification essential.

operating_view: Operators must confirm current datastore backends before upgrading and test representative service flows, ingress policies, and telemetry coverage after deployment.
watch_items: Verify live network paths and effective routing states after upgrades.
Confirm datastore backends before initiating cluster upgrades.
Test telemetry coverage and policy enforcement post-upgrade.
